additions.reason: The overarching secret that Boaz and Rut embody. The text states explicitly: 'sheBo'az veRut hem sod semichat geulah l'tefillah'. This concept bridges both packages as the encompassing framework. Could be assigned to either package or treated as a meta-concept. Assigned here to Package 1 (Rut/Tefillah) because tefillah is the receiving/destination side of the semicha.
additions.source_quote: שֶׁבֹּעַז וְרוּת הֵם סוֹד סְמִיכַת גְּאֻלָּה לִתְפִלָּה

additions.reason: David is the link between Rut and tefillah — Rut is called by her name because from her descended David who saturated God with songs and praises. David is the mediating concept that explains WHY Rut is bchinat tefillah. He could be a bechina node connecting to both Rut and tefillah.
additions.source_quote: שֶׁיָּצָא מִמֶּנָּה דָּוִד, שֶׁרִוָּה לְהַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא בְּשִׁירוֹת וְתִשְׁבָּחוֹת

additions.reason: Songs and praises — the specific mode of tefillah that connects Rut to prayer through David. This is the content of the tefillah dimension.

concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.concept_en: Joining redemption to prayer (semichat geulah l'tefillah)
concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.note: The overarching secret that the Boaz-Rut relationship embodies. This is a halachic/kabbalistic concept — the practice of joining the blessing of geulah directly to the Amidah prayer.
Mediating concept between Rut and tefillah. Rut's name is explained through David who descended from her.
David's specific mode of tefillah that defines the Rut-tefillah bechina connection.

Mentioned in the second part of the torah (paragraph 3-4) — every word the Rebbe reveals to the world has all upper and lower worlds dependent on it. This is a separate topic from the Boaz-Rut teaching and contains no bechina language.
The Rebbe's private attainments, which he values less than what he reveals to the world. Part of the secondary teaching in this torah, no bechina language.
